details.further_information: Leipzig paid €20 million to Göztepe for Rômulo. 20 percent of this amount (€4 million) is distributed to his former clubs as a sell-on fee. Of this €4 million, €2.8 million (70%) goes to Athletico Paranaense and €1.2 million (30%) goes to Maringá FC.
